changes.title: Audio test drift
items: The audio test tells the audio clock drifting apart from real glitches, and links to a new music stall test: does the music cut out when the game freezes for a moment?

changes.title: Youth last berry
items: Youths following you now stop eating berries one short of becoming adults: the last berry is only eaten at a sigil you put down, so nothing turns heavy on you by accident

changes.title: New islands
items: New islands sparkle on the sea chart until you've sailed there, and the compass pin points at them
After a night, the pointer leads you to the map table while there's an island you haven't visited, and only then to bed
